seoTitle: Payment Fee Calculator: Charge So You Net a Target Amount
metaDescription: Work out a payment processing fee, or the amount to charge so you receive an exact net after a percent plus fixed fee. Stripe and PayPal style.
intro: Calculates a processing fee on a charge, or the charge you need so that the amount you receive after fees is a target.
why:
If you want to receive 100 and the processor takes 2.9 percent plus 0.30, charging 100 leaves you short. The right charge is (100 + 0.30) divided by (1 - 0.029). People often add 2.9 percent to 100, which is slightly too little.

Enter the percentage and fixed fee from your processor's pricing page. The tool shows the fee, the charge and a check that works the fee back to your target. Passing fees on to customers is restricted in some places, so check the rules where you sell.
howTo: Choose whether you want the fee on a charge or the charge for a net.
Enter the amount and your percentage and fixed fee.
Read the result and the check line.
